literature.headline_zh: 埃博拉病毒类群本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期埃博拉病毒类群研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 分析确定了七个不连续区中的69个地点,包括医疗设施、金矿、学校和交通枢纽,并绘制了本地和跨境旅行路线及旅行原因。 [10.1016/j.ijid.2026.109238]
研究结果表明,患者对埃博拉治疗中心的信任受到护理质量、沟通、生存率和机构行为的影响。发现临床护理质量通过改变传染接触的时间和地点,影响了传播的动态。 [10.1097/id9.0000000000000228]
在监测数据中,860条可调用的拷贝中出现了两个仅基于共识的单个位点变异。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11661270/v1]
本研究报告了总共 120 例 埃博拉病毒病 确诊病例,病死率为 75%,且在 暴发 的第一个月内达到高峰。 [10.1093/ajrccm/aamag588]
在HCA模型下,40岁男性患者的死亡预计会导致总福利损失Int$120,944和生产力损失Int$40,763。使用不同的折现率和预期寿命重新估算模型显示了损失估算的变化。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11632681/v1]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The analysis identified 69 locations across seven non‐contiguous districts, including healthcare facilities, gold mines, schools, and transportation hubs, and mapped local and cross‐border travel routes and reasons for travel. [10.1016/j.ijid.2026.109238]

The results indicated that trust in Ebola treatment centers was influenced by the quality of care, communication, survival rates, and institutional behavior. Clinical quality was found to shape transmission by altering the timing and location of infectious contact. [10.1097/id9.0000000000000228]
Two consensus-only single-position departures occurred among 860 callable copies in the surveillance data. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11661270/v1]
The study reported a total of 120 confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease, with a case fatality rate of 75% and a peak incidence during the first month of the outbreak. [10.1093/ajrccm/aamag588]

Under the HCA model, the death of the 40-year-old male patient is expected to result in a total welfare loss of Int$120,944 and a productivity loss of Int$40,763. Re-estimating the models with different discount rates and life expectancies showed variations in the estimated losses. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11632681/v1]

news.headline_zh: 埃博拉病毒类群本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期埃博拉病毒类群新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 世界卫生组织健康紧急事件EPI-WIN网络研讨会提供了当前埃博拉邦迪布古亚病毒病暴发的更新信息,该活动被报告为由世界卫生组织主办的网络研讨会。 [news-c77cde1ccb452344]
正在监测埃博拉邦迪布古yo病毒病暴发,欧盟的应对措施通过对外行动署(DG ECHO)的每日地图得到突出显示。该事件被确认为暴发,并由ReliefWeb报告。 [news-72aa0ae4a401d049]
继刚果民主共和国和乌干达出现 暴发 病例以及肯尼亚内罗毕出现输入性 BVD 病例之后,世卫组织正在东地中海区域加强针对本迪布焦病毒病(BVD)的准备工作。该地区尚未出现确诊病例,但准备工作正在进行中。 [news-3ac43eec94f9d0d1]
世界卫生组织(WHO)发布了公共卫生指导方针,以应对在脆弱人群中预防和控制刚果盆地病毒病的传播。 [news-2275810c6ed72e41]
一个多国邦迪布古暴发(BVD)仍在持续,刚果民主共和国境内持续存在传播,而肯尼亚和尼日利亚的输入病例需要继续监测和应对。该报告是IOM发布的官方情况报告。 [news-5a15be2f46682345]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Ebola viruses news developments.
key_findings_en: WHO Health Emergencies EPI-WIN webinar provided an update on the current Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak, with the event reported as a webinar hosted by the World Health Organization. [news-c77cde1ccb452344]

An Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak is being monitored, with the EU response highlighted through DG ECHO's Daily Map. The event is confirmed as an outbreak, reported by ReliefWeb. [news-72aa0ae4a401d049]

WHO is scaling up readiness for Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) in the Eastern Mediterranean Region, following outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and an imported BVD case in Nairobi, Kenya. No confirmed cases in the region yet, but preparations are underway. [news-3ac43eec94f9d0d1]
Public health guidance was issued by the World Health Organization (WHO) to address the prevention and control of Bundibugyo virus disease in vulnerable populations. [news-2275810c6ed72e41]

A multi-country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease (BVD) outbreak remained active, with sustained transmission in the DRC and imported cases requiring continued surveillance and response in Kenya and Nigeria. The report is an official situation report by IOM. [news-5a15be2f46682345]

WHO Health Emergencies EPI-WIN webinar provided an update on the current Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak, with the event reported as a webinar hosted by the World Health Organization. [news-c77cde1ccb452344]. An Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak is being monitored, with the EU response highlighted through DG ECHO's Daily Map. The event is confirmed as an outbreak, reported by ReliefWeb. [news-72aa0ae4a401d049]. WHO is scaling up readiness for Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) in the Eastern Mediterranean Region, following outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and an imported BVD case in Nairobi, Kenya. Public health guidance was issued by the World Health Organization (WHO) to address the prevention and control of Bundibugyo virus disease in vulnerable populations. [news-2275810c6ed72e41].

papers.title: Bundibugyo virus disease in outbreak settings: A practical clinical review
papers.abstract: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) is a severe filovirus infection caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), an orthoebolavirus with diagnostic and countermeasure implications distinct from Ebola virus (EBOV). The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded substantially, with 7890 confirmed cases and 3799 deaths reported across 63 health zones in seven provinces as of 23 September 2026. BVD usually presents as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal illness; haemorrhagic manifestations are uncommon at presentation. Early outbreak investigation also showed that EBOV-oriented testing can fail to detect BDBV, making species-appropriate molecular testing essential when BDBV is epidemiologically plausible. Supportive care remains the standard of management, but what can be delivered safely differs between peripheral facilities and dedicated filovirus treatment centres. First-contact facilities should prioritise recognition, separation, protected sampling, treatment of immediately life-threatening or common treatable conditions, and early referral; treatment centres can provide closer monitoring, advanced supportive care, and access to approved research protocols. Insecurity, displacement, laboratory and transport constraints, and delayed presentation continue to limit implementation. No vaccine or specific therapeutic has established clinical efficacy against BDBV in humans; Ervebo is being evaluated within research protocols and the PARTNERS trial is evaluating MBP134 and remdesivir-based regimens. This review synthesises historical and current evidence on recognition, diagnosis, clinical care, infection prevention, referral, and emerging countermeasures in outbreak-affected settings.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a severe filovirus infection caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), an orthoebolavirus distinct from Ebola virus (EBOV). It highlights the clinical presentation of BVD as a nonspecific febrile and gastrointestinal illness, with rare haemorrhagic manifestations. The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reported 7890 confirmed cases and 3799 deaths as of 23 September 2026. The review emphasizes the importance of species-appropriate molecular testing for BDBV, as EBOV-oriented tests may fail to detect it. It also outlines the limitations in outbreak management due to insecurity, displacement, and logistical challenges. Currently, no vaccine or specific therapeutic has established clinical efficacy against BDBV, with Ervebo and the PARTNERS trial evaluating potential treatments. The review underscores the need for tailored supportive care, with peripheral facilities focusing on immediate life-threatening conditions and early referral, while dedicated treatment centres provide advanced care and access to research protocols.

papers.title: Characterizing population movement patterns during a Sudan Virus Disease outbreak to adjust response efforts, Uganda, 2022.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: In September 2022, Uganda declared a Sudan virus disease outbreak in Mubende District. The Uganda Ministry of Health sought to characterize population movement patterns to identify areas at heightened transmission risk and guide outbreak response efforts. METHODS: From September to December 2022, response teams adapted the Population Connectivity Across Borders (PopCAB) method to conduct focus group discussions, key informant interviews, and participatory mapping with case-contacts and community members across three districts. Results characterizing local and cross-border travel routes and reasons for travel were applied to adjust response actions. RESULTS: Participants identified 69 locations across seven non-contiguous districts, including healthcare facilities, gold mines, schools, and transportation hubs linked to travel for trade, farming, healthcare, and family visits. Ministry of Health response teams used the results to enhance surveillance, risk communication, and infection prevention measures at priority locations including cross-border areas. Surveillance activities adjusted by the PopCAB results directly detected two cases in Kampala and indirectly identified 26 additional cases in newly targeted districts. CONCLUSIONS: Integrating community-based mobility mapping into contact tracing enabled rapid identification of high-risk areas beyond the outbreak epicenter. Response teams in similar settings can rapidly deploy this approach to generate real-time mobility data, improve resource allocation, and strengthen communicable disease containment efforts.

source_records.abstract: OBJECTIVES: In September 2022, Uganda declared a Sudan virus disease outbreak in Mubende District. The Uganda Ministry of Health sought to characterize population movement patterns to identify areas at heightened transmission risk and guide outbreak response efforts. METHODS: From September to December 2022, response teams adapted the Population Connectivity Across Borders (PopCAB) method to conduct focus group discussions, key informant interviews, and participatory mapping with case-contacts and community members across three districts. Results characterizing local and cross-border travel routes and reasons for travel were applied to adjust response actions. RESULTS: Participants identified 69 locations across seven non-contiguous districts, including healthcare facilities, gold mines, schools, and transportation hubs linked to travel for trade, farming, healthcare, and family visits. Ministry of Health response teams used the results to enhance surveillance, risk communication, and infection prevention measures at priority locations including cross-border areas. Surveillance activities adjusted by the PopCAB results directly detected two cases in Kampala and indirectly identified 26 additional cases in newly targeted districts. CONCLUSIONS: Integrating community-based mobility mapping into contact tracing enabled rapid identification of high-risk areas beyond the outbreak epicenter. Response teams in similar settings can rapidly deploy this approach to generate real-time mobility data, improve resource allocation, and strengthen communicable disease containment efforts.

analysis.summary_en: In September 2022 Uganda declared a Sudan virus disease outbreak in Mubende District, prompting the Ministry of Health to investigate population movement patterns to identify high‐risk areas. From September to December 2022, response teams used the PopCAB method, conducting focus groups, key informant interviews, and participatory mapping with case‐contacts and community members across three districts. The approach mapped 69 locations across seven districts, including healthcare facilities, gold mines, schools, and transport hubs, and identified local and cross‐border travel routes and motivations. Integrating community‐based mobility mapping into contact tracing enabled rapid identification of high‐risk areas beyond the epicenter, a novel application of PopCAB in an Ebola‐virus outbreak. The Ministry of Health applied these findings to enhance surveillance, risk communication, and infection prevention, detecting two cases in Kampala and 26 additional cases in newly targeted districts.

papers.abstract_zh: OBJECTIVES: 在2022年9月,乌干达在穆本德区宣布爆发暴发苏丹病毒病。乌干达卫生部希望描述人口流动模式,以识别高传播风险区域并指导暴发应对措施。METHODS: 2022年9月至12月期间,应对团队调整了跨边界人口连通性(PopCAB)方法,与三个区的病例接触者和社区成员进行了焦点小组讨论、关键信息人访谈和参与式地图绘制。结果描述了本地和跨境旅行路线及旅行原因,用于调整应对行动。RESULTS: 参与者确定了七个不连续区中的69个地点,包括医疗设施、金矿、学校和与贸易、农业、医疗和家庭访问相关的交通枢纽。卫生部应对团队利用这些结果,在优先地点(包括跨境地区)加强了监测、风险沟通和感染预防措施。根据PopCAB结果调整的监测活动直接在坎帕拉发现了2例病例,并间接识别了新目标区中的另外26例病例。CONCLUSIONS: 将基于社区的移动性地图整合到接触追踪中,使快速识别出暴发疫区以外的高风险区域成为可能。在类似环境中,应对团队可以迅速部署这种方法,以生成实时移动性数据,改善资源分配,并加强传染病防控工作。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the epidemiology and clinical characteristics of Ebola virus outbreaks to better understand the disease burden and improve public health responses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in multiple outbreak-affected regions and included patients diagnosed with Ebola virus disease during the specified time period.
analysis.methods: The researchers used clinical data and laboratory confirmation to identify cases and analyzed the transmission patterns and demographic factors associated with the outbreaks.
analysis.main_results: The study reported a total of 120 confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease, with a case fatality rate of 75% and a peak incidence during the first month of the outbreak.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the severity of the disease and the rapid progression of outbreaks, providing novel insights into the clinical and epidemiological features of the virus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform targeted surveillance and intervention strategies to mitigate the spread and impact of Ebola virus disease in affected communities.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational nature and potential biases in case reporting, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study on the Ebola Virus Outbreak focuses on understanding the epidemiology and clinical characteristics of the disease. It reports 120 confirmed cases with a 75% case fatality rate, emphasizing the severity and rapid progression of outbreaks. The findings provide novel insights into the clinical and epidemiological features of the virus, which can inform targeted surveillance and intervention strategies. However, the study's observational design and potential biases limit the confidence in its conclusions, resulting in a moderate evidence strength assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 流行病学 和 埃博拉病毒 暴发 的临床特征,以更好地了解疾病负担并改进公共卫生应对措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在多个 暴发 受影响地区进行,并包括在指定时间段内被诊断为 埃博拉病毒病 的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员利用临床数据和实验室确认来识别病例,并分析 传播 模式及与 暴发 相关的流行病学因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究报告了总共 120 例 埃博拉病毒病 确诊病例,病死率为 75%,且在 暴发 的第一个月内达到高峰。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了该疾病的严重性以及 暴发 的快速进展,为病毒的临床和流行病学特征提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为针对性的 监测 和干预策略提供信息,以减少 埃博拉病毒病 在受影响社区中的传播和影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究的观察性质以及病例报告中的潜在偏倚,研究结果的置信度评估为中等。

papers.title: The welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of an index case of Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease reported in Kenya on 6 October 2026
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (EBVD) was imported into Kenya from the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 3 October 2026. Economic evidence is lacking to inform Kenya’s Ministry of Health’s advocacy for domestic and external investment to bolster prevention, mitigation, preparedness, and response to EBVD. This study aimed to estimate, from an economy-wide (societal) perspective, the discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya on 6 October 2026. Methods Drawing on various secondary sources, this study uses the human capital approach (HCA), the willingness-to-pay small (WTP_S) and large (WTP_L) models, and the willingness-to-accept small (WTA_S) and large (WTA_L) models to estimate discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya. To assess the robustness of the results, the five models were each re-estimated four times, assuming (i) a 5% discount rate, (ii) a 10% discount rate, (iii) Africa’s highest male average life expectancy at birth, 74.55 years in Tunisia, and (iv) the world’s highest male average life expectancy, 84.78 years in Monaco. Results Under the HCA model, the death of the 40-year-old male patient is expected to result in a total welfare loss of Int$120,944 and a productivity loss of Int$40,763. Using the implied WTP approach, the expected welfare loss would be between Int$423,302 and Int$786,133, with a productivity loss of between Int$142,669 and Int$264,957. Applying the implied WTA approach yields a welfare loss of Int$1,269,907 to Int$4,051,608 and a productivity loss of Int$428,007 to Int$1,365,546. Re-estimating the HCA, WTP_S, WTP_L, WTA_S, and WTA_L models with 5% and 10% discount rates reduced the estimated welfare and productivity losses by about 17% and 45%, respectively. Re-running the welfare and productivity loss models with Africa's and the world’s highest male life expectancies increased the welfare loss estimates by about 35% and 54%, respectively. Conclusions The death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya will likely lead to significant welfare and productivity losses. Kenya’s Ministry of Health should continue advocacy with the whole-of-government, the private sector, civil society, and development partners to urgently increase investment to bridge gaps in International Health Regulations core capacities, universal health coverage, and WASH (water, sanitation, and hygiene), thereby mitigating the risk of EBVD becoming a national epidemic.

The study's reliance on secondary sources and models introduces some uncertainty, but the findings provide valuable insights for policy decisions.

papers.title_zh: 肯尼亚2026年10月6日报告的埃博拉邦迪布古病毒病索引病例死亡所关联的福利和生产力损失
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (EBVD) was imported into Kenya from the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 3 October 2026. Economic evidence is lacking to inform Kenya’s Ministry of Health’s advocacy for domestic and external investment to bolster prevention, mitigation, preparedness, and response to EBVD. This study aimed to estimate, from an economy-wide (societal) perspective, the discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya on 6 October 2026. Methods Drawing on various secondary sources, this study uses the human capital approach (HCA), the willingness-to-pay small (WTP_S) and large (WTP_L) models, and the willingness-to-accept small (WTA_S) and large (WTA_L) models to estimate discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya. To assess the robustness of the results, the five models were each re-estimated four times, assuming (i) a 5% discount rate, (ii) a 10% discount rate, (iii) Africa’s highest male average life expectancy at birth, 74.55 years in Tunisia, and (iv) the world’s highest male average life expectancy, 84.78 years in Monaco. Results Under the HCA model, the death of the 40-year-old male patient is expected to result in a total welfare loss of Int$120,944 and a productivity loss of Int$40,763. Using the implied WTP approach, the expected welfare loss would be between Int$423,302 and Int$786,133, with a productivity loss of between Int$142,669 and Int$264,957. Applying the implied WTA approach yields a welfare loss of Int$1,269,907 to Int$4,051,608 and a productivity loss of Int$428,007 to Int$1,365,546. Re-estimating the HCA, WTP_S, WTP_L, WTA_S, and WTA_L models with 5% and 10% discount rates reduced the estimated welfare and productivity losses by about 17% and 45%, respectively. Re-running the welfare and productivity loss models with Africa's and the world’s highest male life expectancies increased the welfare loss estimates by about 35% and 54%, respectively. Conclusions The death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya will likely lead to significant welfare and productivity losses. Kenya’s Ministry of Health should continue advocacy with the whole-of-government, the private sector, civil society, and development partners to urgently increase investment to bridge gaps in International Health Regulations core capacities, universal health coverage, and WASH (water, sanitation, and hygiene), thereby mitigating the risk of EBVD becoming a national epidemic.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 引言:埃博拉邦迪布古病毒病(EBVD)于2026年10月3日从刚果民主共和国传入肯尼亚。目前缺乏经济证据来支持肯尼亚卫生部在公共卫生领域倡导国内和国际投资以加强EBVD的预防、缓解、准备和响应能力。本研究旨在从全社会视角估算肯尼亚2026年10月6日报告的EBVD索引病例死亡所导致的折现后的福利和生产力损失。方法 本研究借鉴多种二次资料来源,采用人力资本方法(HCA)、意愿支付小(WTP_S)和大(WTP_L)模型,以及意愿接受小(WTA_S)和大(WTA_L)模型,以估算肯尼亚EBVD索引病例死亡所导致的折现后的福利和生产力损失。为评估结果的稳健性,每种模型均在四种假设下重新估算:(i)5%的折现率,(ii)10%的折现率,(iii)非洲男性最高出生时平均预期寿命74.55年(突尼斯),(iv)世界男性最高出生时平均预期寿命84.78年(摩纳哥)。结果 在HCA模型下,40岁男性患者的死亡预计会导致总福利损失Int$120,944和生产力损失Int$40,763。使用隐含意愿支付方法,预计福利损失范围为Int$423,302至Int$786,133,生产力损失范围为Int$142,669至Int$264,957。应用隐含意愿接受方法,预计福利损失为Int$1,269,907至Int$4,051,608,生产力损失为Int$428,007至Int$1,365,546。使用5%和10%的折现率重新估算HCA、WTP_S、WTP_L、WTA_S和WTA_L模型,分别使福利和生产力损失的估算减少了约17%和45%。使用非洲和世界最高男性预期寿命重新运行福利和生产力损失模型,使福利损失的估算分别增加了约35%和54%。结论 肯尼亚EBVD索引病例的死亡很可能会导致显著的福利和生产力损失。肯尼亚卫生部应继续与政府各部门、私营部门、民间社会和开发伙伴合作,紧急增加投资以弥补国际卫生条例核心能力、全民健康覆盖和水、卫生与环境卫生(WASH)方面的差距,从而降低EBVD成为全国性流行病的风险。

papers.title: Known pathogen, unprepared system: Bundibugyo virus and the diagnostic preparedness gap
papers.abstract: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exposed a fundamental weakness in global diagnostic preparedness. Although BDBV had been recognized for nearly two decades and diagnostic tools existed, gaps across the diagnostic ecosystem delayed outbreak recognition and response. Scientific capability existed, but a resilient diagnostic ecosystem capable of translating existing technologies into timely public health action was lacking. The response to the BDBV outbreak should be understood not as an isolated diagnostic failure, but as a case study demonstrating why preparedness strategies built around individual pathogens are insufficient for future epidemic and pandemic threats. Diagnostic preparedness must shift toward adaptable syndromic and viral-family platforms, regional sequencing capacity, integrated surveillance systems, pre-positioned regulatory and validation pathways, resilient manufacturing, sustainable inter-epidemic financing, and clear global accountability. The outbreak raises broader questions. If the global community struggles to deploy diagnostics for a known pathogen, it is unlikely to respond effectively to a novel or highly divergent one. Building a fit-for-purpose diagnostic preparedness ecosystem is essential for achieving the 100 Days Mission and future pandemic preparedness.

Despite BDBV being recognized for nearly two decades, the diagnostic ecosystem failed to translate existing technologies into timely public health action. The authors argue that the response to this outbreak should be viewed as a case study illustrating the inadequacy of pathogen-specific preparedness strategies for future threats. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2026年刚果民主共和国发生的邦迪布古病毒(BDBV)暴发暴露出全球诊断准备体系中的根本性弱点。尽管BDBV已被识别近二十年,且存在诊断工具,但诊断生态系统中的差距导致了暴发的识别和应对延迟。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对2026年刚果民主共和国发生的邦迪布古病毒暴发的案例研究。它通过分析对这一暴发的应对情况,探讨诊断准备不足的差距。
elements_zh.methods: 诊断准备必须转向适应性强的综合征和病毒家族平台,区域基因组测序能力,整合的监测系统,预先部署的监管和验证路径,韧性制造,可持续的流行间资金支持,以及明确的全球问责机制。
elements_zh.main_results: 对BDBV 暴发的应对不应被理解为一次孤立的诊断失败,而应被视为一个案例研究,说明以单个病原体为中心的准备策略不足以应对未来的流行病和大流行威胁。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 如果全球社会难以对已知病原体部署诊断工具,那么对于新出现或高度变异的病原体,很可能无法有效应对。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 暴发引发了关于为何需要一个更具韧性和适应性的诊断生态系统来应对未来流行病和大流行威胁的更广泛问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究的具体局限性,但总体含义表明,由于依赖单一案例研究,证据强度中等。

papers.title: The Attenuation Paradox in Bundibugyo Virus Disease: Case Fatality, Ascertainment, and Delayed Outbreak Recognition
papers.abstract: Bundibugyo virus has caused three recognised outbreaks, and each was recognised late. The usual reading of that record treats the delay as a failure of investment, diagnostics or governance. This review sets out a partly mechanistic alternative: the low case fatality ratio observed early in a Bundibugyo virus outbreak is itself one of the conditions that produces the delay, and the delay in turn depresses the observed ratio further. The evidence is organised around three comparison tables: the burden, severity and recognition interval of each outbreak; the presenting clinical features set against a matched Ebola virus series; and the point at which species assignment failed in each event. A schematic draws the relationships together. Two findings emerge. The clinical syndrome does not discriminate between species: haemorrhage was documented in roughly a quarter of confirmed patients in both the 2007–08 Bundibugyo series and a 2014 Ebola virus series, so the presenting picture cannot carry the explanatory weight often placed on it. The discriminating failures are instead genomic and diagnostic, and the early case fatality ratio operates as a surveillance trigger that is biased downward precisely when ascertainment is narrowest. The 2026 epidemic, in which the confirmed ratio rose from 12.1% to 44.3% while the virus doubled every 5.5 days, fits this account better than it fits a change in virulence. A fatality ratio from the first weeks of a filovirus outbreak should therefore be read as an index of surveillance maturity rather than of danger, and escalation should be governed by species-inclusive confirmation.
papers.journal: Sebha University Journal of Medical Sciences

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the attenuation paradox in Bundibugyo virus disease, focusing on the delayed recognition of outbreaks and the low case fatality ratio observed early in these events. It challenges the conventional interpretation that delays are due to failures in investment, diagnostics, or governance, proposing instead that the low fatality ratio itself contributes to delayed outbreak recognition. papers.abstract_zh: 邦迪布古病毒已引发三次被确认的暴发,且每次均被延迟确认。通常对这一记录的解读将延迟归因于投资、诊断或治理的失败。本文提出了一种部分机制性的替代观点:在邦迪布古病毒暴发初期观察到的低病例死亡率本身就是导致延迟的一个条件,而延迟反过来又进一步压低了观察到的死亡率。证据围绕三个比较表格组织:每次暴发的负担、严重程度和识别间隔;临床表现与匹配的埃博拉病毒系列进行对比;以及每次事件中物种分类失败的时间点。一个示意图将这些关系整合在一起。两个主要发现浮现。临床综合征无法区分物种:在2007–08年的邦迪布古系列和2014年的埃博拉病毒系列中,大约四分之一的确认患者都出现了出血现象,因此初始表现无法承担通常赋予它的解释权重。区分失败则源于基因组和诊断层面,而早期病例死亡率比率在确认范围最狭窄时会向下偏倚,从而充当监测的触发因素。2026年的疫情中,确认死亡率从12.1%上升至44.3%,同时病毒每5.5天翻倍一次,这比将其归因于病毒毒力变化更符合这一解释。因此,从丝状病毒暴发初期几周内获得的死亡率比率应被解读为监测成熟度的指标,而非危险程度,而疫情升级应由包含所有物种的确认来指导。

papers.title: Live-cell diffracted X-ray blinking reveals Ebola virus VP40-driven budding dynamics and their regulation by cytoskeletal and lipid factors
papers.abstract: Ebolavirus VP40 drives viral budding by remodeling the plasma membrane, yet the underlying real-time dynamics remain poorly understood. Here, we applied Diffracted X-ray Blinking (DXB) to investigate how E bolavirus VP40 affects membrane dynamics in living cells by monitoring millisecond-scale fluctuations in X-ray diffraction intensity. Expression of wild-type VP40 (wtVP40) from Zaire ebolavirus induced a progressive increase in membrane fluctuations, whereas the dimerization-defective mutant L117R and the oligomerization-deficient mutant I307R failed to enhance membrane motion despite comparable protein expression levels. Consistent with these findings, only wtVP40 was efficiently released into the culture medium, indicating that increased membrane fluctuations correlate with budding competence. DXB analysis further showed that wtVP40 increased the fast-moving population with higher decay constants, whereas the L117R and I307R mutants showed limited changes in the decay-constant distributions. Pharmacological perturbation studies demonstrated that VP40-induced membrane fluctuations are sensitive to both cytoskeletal integrity and phosphatidylserine availability. Expression of VP40 from Reston ebola virus similarly enhanced membrane dynamics, suggesting that VP40-mediated membrane remodeling is conserved among E bolaviruses . DXB-based membrane-motion analysis may therefore provide biophysical markers for viral assembly and a basis for evaluating budding-targeted antiviral strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the real-time dynamics of Ebolavirus VP40 in driving viral budding by using Diffracted X-ray Blinking (DXB) to monitor millisecond-scale membrane fluctuations in living cells. The research found that wild-type VP40 from Zaire ebolavirus significantly increased membrane motion, while dimerization and oligomerization-defective mutants did not, despite similar protein expression levels. These results were corroborated by the observation that only wild-type VP40 was efficiently released into the culture medium, indicating a correlation between membrane fluctuations and budding competence. The study also demonstrated that VP40-induced membrane fluctuations are influenced by cytoskeletal integrity and phosphatidylserine availability. The findings suggest that VP40-mediated membrane remodeling is conserved across Ebolaviruses, highlighting potential biophysical markers for viral assembly and antiviral strategies targeting budding. The evidence is strong, with clear results and implications for understanding viral mechanisms.

papers.abstract_zh: 埃博拉病毒VP40通过重塑细胞膜驱动病毒出芽,但其背后的实时动态机制仍不明确。在这里,我们应用了散射X射线闪烁(DXB)技术,通过监测毫秒级尺度的X射线衍射强度波动,研究VP40如何影响活细胞中的膜动态。来自扎伊尔埃博拉病毒的野生型VP40(wtVP40)表达导致膜波动逐渐增加,而二聚化缺陷型突变体L117R和寡聚化缺陷型突变体I307R尽管蛋白表达水平相当,却未能增强膜运动。这些结果一致表明,只有wtVP40能有效释放到培养基中,说明膜波动的增加与出芽能力相关。DXB分析进一步显示,wtVP40增加了具有较高衰减常数的快速运动群体,而L117R和I307R突变体在衰减常数分布上变化有限。药理学扰动研究表明,VP40诱导的膜波动对细胞骨架完整性和磷脂酰丝氨酸的可用性均敏感。来自雷斯顿埃博拉病毒的VP40表达同样增强了膜动态,表明VP40介导的膜重塑在埃博拉病毒中是保守的。因此,基于DXB的膜运动分析可能为病毒组装提供生物物理标志,并为针对出芽的策略评估奠定基础。

papers.title: Measurement Error Correction and Multidimensional Aggregation in Epidemiological Surveillance Systems: Application to the Ebola Virus Disease Epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
papers.abstract: Epidemiological surveillance systems produce decision-making indicators from data that may be affected by under-reporting, misclassification and notification delays. These errors can propagate through the extraction, transformation, loading and multidimensional aggregation stages. This article proposes a mathematical framework that integrates measurement error correction into an ETL–data warehouse–OLAP decision architecture. The central problem is to determine whether the correction of a misclassification error can be performed before or after aggregation without changing the resulting indicator. We show that the Rogan–Gladen estimator commutes with the roll-up operator only when the sensitivity and specificity parameters are homogeneous across the aggregated strata. A numerical instantiation based on a synthetic dataset calibrated on published parameters of the Ebola virus disease epidemic in North Kivu and Ituri (DRC, 2018–2020) illustrates this non-commutation and its consequences for the estimation of incidence and the reproduction number. These results lead to a design rule: when surveillance quality is heterogeneous, correction must be performed at the finest level at which the error parameters can be regarded as homogeneous, before any aggregation, because this is the only strategy that remains unbiased whatever the spatial distribution of cases. A bias–variance analysis (Theorem 4) and a Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis (5,000 replicates, seven scenarios) further show that aggregate-level correction can have a slightly smaller variance but becomes biased when cases concentrate in poorly covered zones, and that the corrected indicators are highly sensitive to the assumed specificity when test positivity is close to the false-positive floor (a misspecification of 0.005 in specificity changes cumulative incidence by more than 100%). No individual-level surveillance data were used: the synthetic data are fully specified by a generation algorithm and a parameter table provided for reproducibility. The proposed framework thus provides a formal basis for designing surveillance decision-support systems that explicitly account for data quality.
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Research in Computer Science

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the challenge of measurement error in epidemiological surveillance systems, particularly in the context of Ebola virus disease. The research demonstrates that the Rogan–Gladen estimator only commutes with the roll-up operator when sensitivity and specificity parameters are homogeneous across aggregated strata. papers.title_zh: 流行病学监测系统中的测量误差校正与多维聚合:应用于刚果民主共和国埃博拉病毒病疫情
papers.source_body_en: Epidemiological surveillance systems produce decision-making indicators from data that may be affected by under-reporting, misclassification and notification delays. These errors can propagate through the extraction, transformation, loading and multidimensional aggregation stages. This article proposes a mathematical framework that integrates measurement error correction into an ETL–data warehouse–OLAP decision architecture. The central problem is to determine whether the correction of a misclassification error can be performed before or after aggregation without changing the resulting indicator. We show that the Rogan–Gladen estimator commutes with the roll-up operator only when the sensitivity and specificity parameters are homogeneous across the aggregated strata. A numerical instantiation based on a synthetic dataset calibrated on published parameters of the Ebola virus disease epidemic in North Kivu and Ituri (DRC, 2018–2020) illustrates this non-commutation and its consequences for the estimation of incidence and the reproduction number. These results lead to a design rule: when surveillance quality is heterogeneous, correction must be performed at the finest level at which the error parameters can be regarded as homogeneous, before any aggregation, because this is the only strategy that remains unbiased whatever the spatial distribution of cases. A bias–variance analysis (Theorem 4) and a Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis (5,000 replicates, seven scenarios) further show that aggregate-level correction can have a slightly smaller variance but becomes biased when cases concentrate in poorly covered zones, and that the corrected indicators are highly sensitive to the assumed specificity when test positivity is close to the false-positive floor (a misspecification of 0.005 in specificity changes cumulative incidence by more than 100%). No individual-level surveillance data were used: the synthetic data are fully specified by a generation algorithm and a parameter table provided for reproducibility. The proposed framework thus provides a formal basis for designing surveillance decision-support systems that explicitly account for data quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 流行病学监测系统从可能受漏报、误分类和通报延迟影响的数据中生成决策指标。这些误差可能在提取、转换、加载和多维聚合阶段传播。本文提出了一种数学框架,将测量误差校正整合到ETL-数据仓库-OLAP决策架构中。核心问题是确定是否可以在聚合之前或之后校正误分类误差,而不会改变最终的指标结果。我们证明了Rogan–Gladen估计器仅在敏感性和特异性参数在聚合分层中保持同质时,才能与roll-up操作符交换。基于北基伏和伊图里地区(刚果民主共和国,2018–2020年)埃博拉病毒病疫情的已发表参数校准的合成数据集的数值实例说明了这种非交换性及其对发病率估计和再生数的影响。这些结果引导出一个设计规则:当监测质量不均时,校正必须在误差参数可视为同质的最细粒度层级上进行,然后再进行任何聚合,因为这是唯一一种无论病例空间分布如何都能保持无偏的策略。偏差-方差分析(定理4)和蒙特卡洛不确定性分析(5,000次重复,七个场景)进一步表明,聚合层级的校正可能具有略微较小的方差,但当病例集中在覆盖不足的区域时会变得有偏,且校正后的指标在测试阳性率接近假阳性下限时对假设的特异性高度敏感(特异性假设误差0.005会导致累计发病率变化超过100%)。未使用个体层面的监测数据:合成数据完全由一个生成算法和一个用于可重复性的参数表指定。因此,所提出的框架为设计明确考虑数据质量的监测决策支持系统提供了正式的基础。

papers.title: Natural genus-exclusive four-position VP24 configuration in Bundibugyo virus links host interferon tone to a testable cell-type ordering
papers.abstract: Abstract Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) causes outbreaks with lower case-fatality than Ebola virus (EBOV); its VP24 carries the only BDBV-specific functional difference mapped to date. That difference was defined in an engineered virus. Here, we integrate a sequence census, a human cell-type expression atlas, and a reanalysis of public infection data to connect the natural BDBV VP24 configuration to host interferon (IFN) tone and derive a testable cell-type ordering of post-entry IFN-mediated restriction. All 31 full-length BDBV VP24 records and all 36 complete 2026 outbreak genomes carried S83/Q135/H140/A141; none of the other five orthoebolavirus species assessed carried the complete set. Two consensus-only single-position departures occurred among 860 callable copies in the surveillance data. Δ, a baseline IFN-tone score, tracks the IFN-stimulated level attained by a cell and predicts the strength of IFN-mediated suppression of viral RNA accumulation in cells infected with BDBV carrying the VP24 defect: high Δ denotes stronger suppression, low Δ weaker. Across 154 human cell types, Δ was higher in surface epithelia and circulating myeloid cells (enterocytes 1.28; monocytes 1.00) than in retinal and testicular cells (retinal pigment epithelium − 1.02; Sertoli cells − 0.68). A competing importin-α model predicted exemption in the 47 cell types with high Δ but low importin-α, including enteric epithelium and hepatocytes. In the HIV-1 restriction panel, Δ discriminated restricted from permissive cells (area under the curve (AUC) 0.87), whereas importin-α was at chance (AUC 0.47–0.50); functional data therefore descriptively support Δ.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the unique VP24 configuration in Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) and its association with host interferon (IFN) tone. The research aimed to connect the natural BDBV VP24 configuration to IFN-mediated restriction in different human cell types. By integrating a sequence census, a human cell-type expression atlas, and reanalysis of public infection data, the study identified that all 31 full-length BDBV VP24 records and 36 complete 2026 outbreak genomes carried the S83/Q135/H140/A141 configuration, which is absent in other orthoebolavirus species. The findings revealed that Δ, a baseline IFN-tone score, correlates with the strength of IFN-mediated suppression of viral RNA accumulation. The study also demonstrated that Δ was higher in surface epithelia and circulating myeloid cells compared to retinal and testicular cells. Additionally, a competing importin-α model predicted exemption in certain cell types with high Δ but low importin-α. These results provide insights into the cell-type-specific restriction of BDBV and highlight the importance of IFN tone in viral dynamics. However, the study's interpretation is limited by the reliance on a competing model and the absence of direct functional validation.

papers.title: Doxycycline and Nitazoxanide as a Candidate Immunomodulatory Combination for the Early Management of Ebola Disease Caused by Bundibugyo Virus
papers.abstract: As of 5 November 2026, Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had produced 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths, with close to two of every three deaths in an earlier WHO reporting interval occurring in communities rather than treatment centres. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this species, and the agents in trials are monoclonal antibodies and direct-acting antivirals. In 2021 I proposed reclassifying COVID-19, Ebola virus disease and Nipah virus infection as a novel acute onset immune dysrhythmia syndrome. Read through it, the pathology now described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques points to two arms: fatal animals showed a myeloid hyperinflammatory profile with raised interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, survivors transcripts of an intact T cell response. Basing on that convergence I propose doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an early immunomodulatory combination, each acting on a different arm. Doxycycline inhibits matrix metalloproteinases at exposures achievable in man, and nitazoxanide amplifies the RIG-I and PKR arm the virus suppresses. To be noted that none of this establishes efficacy in Bundibugyo disease. What it offers is a mechanism worth testing in two licensed, oral, inexpensive drugs on the shelf, with the host-directed concentration still unmeasured. I therefore ask for species-specific work: activity in relevant cells and in the macaque model, the unbound concentration-response relationship, and a two-by-two factorial evaluation, preclinical and clinical, powered for the interaction. I strongly believe the search for safe immunomodulators is the one most likely to end in a drug available on the day it is needed.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore potential immunomodulatory strategies for managing Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus, given the high mortality rate and lack of approved treatments.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where as of 5 November 2026, there were 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths, with a significant proportion of deaths occurring in communities rather than treatment centers.
analysis.methods: The study analyzed pathology in Bundibugyo-infected macaques, identifying distinct immune profiles in fatal and survivor animals, and proposed a mechanism for doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an immunomodulatory combination.
analysis.main_results: Pathology in Bundibugyo-infected macaques showed that fatal cases had a myeloid hyperinflammatory profile with elevated interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, while survivors exhibited an intact T cell response.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as suggesting a potential immunomodulatory approach, proposing doxycycline and nitazoxanide as a combination targeting different immune pathways, based on the observed immune profiles.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of understanding immune dysregulation in Bundibugyo virus disease and suggest a promising avenue for early immunomodulatory interventions, which could be critical for managing outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not establish efficacy in Bundibugyo disease, as it is based on observations in macaques and lacks direct clinical evidence, which limits the strength of the conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an immunomodulatory combination for managing Bundibugyo virus disease. It highlights the high mortality rate and lack of approved treatments for this disease, emphasizing the need for alternative strategies. The research analyzed pathology in infected macaques, revealing distinct immune profiles in fatal and survivor cases. The authors propose that these drugs could target different immune arms, offering a mechanism for further testing. However, the study does not establish efficacy in Bundibugyo disease, underscoring the need for species-specific research. The findings suggest that focusing on immunomodulators may be a viable approach for addressing outbreaks, as these drugs are already available and inexpensive.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨针对布迪布古病毒所致埃博拉病的潜在免疫调节策略,鉴于其高死亡率和缺乏获批的治疗药物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于刚果民主共和国的布迪布古病毒病,截至2026年11月5日,该地区已报告10,741例确诊病例和5,230例死亡,其中大部分死亡发生在社区而非治疗中心。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究分析了布迪布古病毒感染恒河猴的病理特征,识别了致命病例与幸存者之间的不同免疫特征,并提出了多西环素和尼替考酸胺作为免疫调节联合用药的机制。
elements_zh.main_results: 布迪布古病毒感染恒河猴的病理分析表明,致命病例表现出髓系超炎症特征,包括白细胞介素-6和髓过氧化物酶水平升高,而幸存者则显示出完整的T细胞应答。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为提示了一种潜在的免疫调节方法,基于观察到的免疫特征,提议多西环素和尼替考酸胺作为针对不同免疫通路的联合用药。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了理解布迪布古病毒病免疫失调的重要性,并提出了早期免疫调节干预的有前景途径,这可能对管理暴发至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究并未在布迪布古病毒病中证明有效性,因为它基于恒河猴的观察,缺乏直接的临床证据,这限制了结论的强度。

papers.title: Cross-protective potential of Zaire ebolavirus-targeted vaccines against Bundibugyo virus: search strategies and review methods
papers.abstract: Companion file to a PROSPERO registration. Contains the complete, pre-specified search strategies for a systematic review of the cross-protective potential of Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV)-targeted vaccines against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), together with the eligibility criteria and core methodological components of the review. Covers nine bibliographic databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, CENTRAL, CINAHL, Global Index Medicus, African Index Medicus, AJOL), full-text searching, dissertations, seven trial registries, six preprint servers, and regulatory and agency grey literature. Deposited in accordance with PRISMA-S before any search was executed. None of the strategies had been run at the time of deposit.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the cross-protective potential of Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV)-targeted vaccines against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). It examines whether vaccines developed for EBOV can provide protection against BDBV, with an emphasis on human-pathogenic orthoebolaviruses and Ebola virus disease. Reston and Bombali viruses are considered background or comparison entities unless human disease evidence is explicitly present.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic review with pre-specified search strategies, eligibility criteria, and core methodological components. It includes nine bibliographic databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, CENTRAL, CINAHL, Global Index Medicus, African Index Medicus, AJOL), full-text searching, dissertations, seven trial registries, six preprint servers, and regulatory and agency grey literature. The methods were deposited in accordance with PRISMA-S before any search was executed.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review does not report any substantive conclusions or pooled estimates. It outlines the search strategies and methodological framework but does not provide results or interpretations related to the cross-protective potential of EBOV-targeted vaccines against BDBV.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report any controversies or evidence gaps. It does not address conflicting findings, unresolved mechanisms, or missing populations or regions. The evidence base is described but not analyzed for heterogeneity or gaps in the data.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review does not provide specific research or practice implications. It does not outline priorities for surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, vaccination, or policy. The implications section remains unaddressed in the supplied evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This review outlines the methodology for a systematic analysis of the cross-protective potential of Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV)-targeted vaccines against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). It specifies the search strategies, databases, and eligibility criteria used to identify relevant studies. However, it does not present any substantive results, conclusions, or implications. The review emphasizes the importance of systematic and transparent methods in evaluating vaccine efficacy across related viruses, but no findings are reported. The evidence base includes a range of sources, yet no analysis of the data is provided.

papers.full_text: Outbreak control and clinical care are often treated as separate domains. Clinical teams care for patients after admission, whereas public health teams detect cases, conduct contact tracing, organize isolation, communicate risk, and prevent unsafe burials. This separation may be administratively convenient, but it is epidemiologically misleading. In cases of Ebola, care quality and accessibility can influence whether patients disclose symptoms, when they enter isolation, and where they spend the most infectious phase of illness, as well as whether communities cooperate with response actions. Therefore, clinical care is not merely the humanitarian endpoint of an Ebola response. It is an active intervention for outbreak control. The 2026 Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda unfolded amid insecurity, population movement, restricted healthcare access, and pressure on treatment services. With no licensed Bundibugyo virus-specific vaccine or treatment, early recognition, safe referral, infection prevention, and structured supportive care are central to the response.[] The success of isolation, surveillance, and community engagement partly depends on whether the clinical system offers patients a credible chance of recovery. Care determines when isolation begins Ebola transmission frequently occurs before patients reach specialized treatment facilities. Early symptoms are nonspecific and may be mistaken for malaria, enteric infection, or other common febrile illnesses. Patients may remain at home, consult traditional healers, attend private clinics, or move between general healthcare facilities. As the illness progresses, physical caregiving intensifies, and exposure to infectious body fluids increases. The interval between symptom onset and protected care thus represents a clinical delay and is a period within which household, community, and healthcare-associated transmission potentially occurs. Communities do not decide whether to report an illness solely based on public health messages encouraging symptom reporting and early care seeking; they also judge what is likely to happen after reporting. Studies conducted in Sierra Leone have found that during the 2014–2016 West African Ebola epidemic, trust in Ebola treatment centers was shaped by experiences of care, communication, survival, and institutional behavior.[] Clinical quality shapes transmission not by altering viral biology but by changing the timing and location of infectious contact. Accessible, trustworthy care can encourage earlier presentation, allowing patients to spend a greater proportion of their infectious period in settings designed for isolation and infection prevention rather than in unprotected households or ordinary clinics. Treatment centers must be places of care An isolation space is not necessarily a treatment bed. Functional Ebola care requires trained staff, continuous nursing observation, essential medicines, basic laboratory support, reliable supplies, infection prevention, water, electricity, and safe waste management. Supportive care includes assessing and treating dehydration, electrolyte and glucose abnormalities, shock, hypoxemia, pain, distress, and coinfections and addressing the specific needs of children and pregnant women.[] Early admission is important. An analysis of patients treated during the 2018–2020 Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo showed that each additional day between symptom onset and treatment center admission was associated with increased mortality, although those patients had Ebola virus disease and access to effective monoclonal antibodies.[] This finding cannot be extended directly to Bundibugyo virus disease, but the underlying principle is relevant: Delayed entry into care can allow further clinical deterioration and prolong opportunities for unprotected exposure. Clinical quality is not the sole determinant of survival. Outcomes depend on the viral species, viral load, and disease severity as well as the patient’s age, pregnancy status, comorbidities, and access to specific treatment. A center that offers little beyond separation may reinforce the belief that admission has no benefit. A center that provides competent, compassionate care can produce visible survivors and make early referrals more acceptable. Isolation removes infectious patients from a community; quality treatment gives the community a reason to accept that removal. Trust is reinforced or undermined at the bedside Community engagement is primarily seen as communication oriented—that is, explaining transmission, addressing rumors, encouraging reporting, and promoting safe burial. These activities are indispensable, but communication cannot compensate indefinitely for poor clinical experience. Trust is produced not only by what response teams say but also by what patients and families observe them doing: whether suffering is treated, information is shared, families are allowed to maintain safe contact, and patients are treated with dignity. During the 2018–2019 outbreak in North Kivu, low institutional trust and belief in misinformation were associated with lower acceptance of preventive behaviors and vaccination.[] This does not mean that better care alone creates trust. Political history, insecurity, inequality, coercive practices, and local customs remain important influences. A damaging feedback loop can emerge when limited or inaccessible care leads to delayed presentation, advanced disease, high observed mortality, and an increased fear of treatment centers. The reverse is also plausible: Accessible, effective, and dignified care can lead to visible recovery, which may strengthen trust, encourage earlier presentation, and reduce unprotected exposure (Figure 1). Thus, community trust is partly a clinical outcome. The Ebola care system extends beyond treatment centers Patients with unrecognized Ebola disease often first attend community clinics, emergency departments, maternity services, private hospitals, pharmacies, or facilities treating presumed malaria or bacterial infections. Early experiences from the 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak highlight healthcare worker infections, unsafe triage approaches, limited isolation capacity, and infection prevention vulnerabilities.[] Therefore, ordinary facilities must be able to recognize compatible syndromes, obtain exposure histories, initiate precautions, safely isolate patients with suspected Ebola disease, provide initial stabilization, notify public health authorities, and arrange protected transfers. These capabilities must coexist with continued care for common febrile illnesses, as most patients presenting with fever will not have Ebola disease. During the 2014–2015 outbreak in Tonkolili District, Sierra Leone, the opening of an Ebola management center closer to the affected communities was associated with a reduction in median symptom-to-admission time from six to three days.[] A larger retrospective study of the 2018–2020 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo found that patients presenting to decentralized facilities integrated into existing healthcare structures had modestly shorter admission delays than those presenting to centralized facilities.[] The objective is not universal decentralization but a tiered care network that reduces the geographic, social, and institutional distance between symptom onset and effective treatment. This network would comprise frontline facilities able to recognize, temporarily isolate, and stabilize suspected cases; decentralized units that provide protected assessment and care closer to affected communities; and referral centers that have the capacity for patients requiring more intensive support. Proximity should thus be treated as a clinical and epidemiologic design variable rather than a mere logistical consideration. From principle to practice Translating this principle into practice requires several changes in outbreak preparedness and response. First, the rapid expansion of isolation capacity should be accompanied by a minimum clinical care package with sufficient numbers of appropriately trained staff, continuous nursing care, basic supportive treatment, infection prevention, essential diagnostics, and reliable supplies. Preparedness assessments should measure functional treatment capacity rather than designated bed numbers alone. Second, quality-of-care indicators should be incorporated into outbreak monitoring alongside case detection, laboratory turnaround, and contact follow-up. The time from symptom onset to protected care and the proportion of designated beds capable of delivering continuous, staffed, and supplied care are examples of measures that closely reflect operational readiness. Third, the WHO, ministries of health, and response partners should establish tiered referral networks that link frontline facilities, decentralized care units, and higher-level treatment centers before case numbers surge. Evidence on proximity suggests that bringing protected care closer to affected communities can shorten admission delays.[] Emphasizing quality does not mean delaying the urgently needed expansion of isolation capacity. During rapid epidemic growth, additional physical space may be required before ideal staffing or infrastructure is available. However, physical capacity and functional capacity should not be considered equivalent. Expansion should proceed with a minimum threshold of staffing, infection prevention, basic supportive care, and supply continuity before a bed is counted toward operational treatment capacity. Additional capabilities can then be introduced as resources permit. The relevant trade-off is not simply capacity versus quality but how rapidly physical isolation capacity can be converted into safe and functional clinical capacity. Clinical care is an upstream intervention Governments, health systems, and response partners have an ethical obligation to provide clinical care to patients affected by Ebola outbreaks. This obligation alone justifies investment in care; the additional epidemiological value of that investment should also be recognized. Investment by these actors in nursing, supportive care, infection prevention, referrals, family communication, and the preparedness of ordinary hospitals may improve survival and reduce suffering. It may also make early reporting more acceptable, reduce household caregiving during advanced illness stages, prevent healthcare-associated amplification, and decrease deaths outside protected settings. Contemporary proposals to embed Ebola treatment within stronger health systems emphasize access, dignity, safety, and integration with routine services.[] Clinical teams do not operate downstream of outbreak control. They help determine whether surveillance alerts become patients in care, whether isolation is accepted, and whether community engagement is reinforced or contradicted by lived experiences. Ebola strategies should therefore present treatment centers as places where patients receive the best achievable chance of recovery, not merely as places where infection is contained. Quality clinical care during Ebola outbreaks is not a measure taken after transmission control succeeds. Rather, it is one of the conditions that makes transmission control possible. Funding None. During the 2014–2015 outbreak in Tonkolili District, Sierra Leone, the opening of an Ebola management center closer to the affected communities was associated with a reduction in median symptom-to-admission time from six to three days.[] A larger retrospective study of the 2018–2020 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo found that patients presenting to decentralized facilities integrated into existing healthcare structures had modestly shorter admission delays than those presenting to centralized facilities.[] The objective is not universal decentralization but a tiered care network that reduces the geographic, social, and institutional distance between symptom onset and effective treatment. Outbreak control and clinical care are often treated as separate domains. This separation may be administratively convenient, but it is epidemiologically misleading. papers.title_original: Beyond isolation: Clinical care as an outbreak control intervention for Ebola disease

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to challenge the conventional separation of outbreak control and clinical care in Ebola disease, highlighting the need to recognize clinical care as an integral part of outbreak management. The background emphasized that this separation may be administratively convenient but is epidemiologically misleading.

analysis.methods: The methods involved examining the interplay between clinical care quality, patient behavior, and transmission dynamics during the 2026 outbreak. It included reviewing experiences of care, communication, survival, and institutional behavior that shaped trust in treatment centers.
analysis.main_results: The results indicated that trust in Ebola treatment centers was influenced by the quality of care, communication, survival rates, and institutional behavior. Clinical quality was found to shape transmission by altering the timing and location of infectious contact.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of integrating clinical care into outbreak control efforts, emphasizing the need for accessible, trustworthy treatment facilities to encourage early patient presentation and reduce transmission risks.

analysis.summary_en: This study challenges the traditional separation of clinical care and outbreak control in Ebola disease, arguing that clinical care is an active intervention for managing outbreaks. It analyzed the 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, highlighting how trust in treatment centers is shaped by care quality, communication, survival, and institutional behavior. The findings suggest that clinical care influences transmission dynamics by altering the timing and location of infectious contact. These insights have implications for improving outbreak response strategies by integrating clinical care into public health measures. The study's evidence is moderate in strength, as it is based on observational data rather than experimental methods. Limitations include the lack of direct experimental evidence and potential biases in community behavior reporting.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在挑战埃博拉病毒病中暴发控制与临床护理的传统分离,强调应将临床护理视为暴发管理的重要组成部分。背景强调,这种分离在行政上可能方便,但在流行病学上是误导性的。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了2026年刚果民主共和国和乌干达由邦迪布古病毒引起的埃博拉暴发,重点探讨了临床护理在暴发动态中的作用。研究考虑了患者可能采取的多样化路径,包括家庭、传统治疗师、私人诊所和一般医疗机构。
elements_zh.methods: 研究方法涉及考察2026年暴发期间临床护理质量、患者行为与传播动态之间的相互作用。包括回顾护理经验、沟通、生存率以及机构行为,这些因素塑造了患者对治疗中心的信任。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,患者对埃博拉治疗中心的信任受到护理质量、沟通、生存率和机构行为的影响。发现临床护理质量通过改变传染接触的时间和地点,影响了传播的动态。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为临床护理不仅是人道主义终点,而且是暴发控制的主动干预措施。这一见解在将临床护理作为暴发应对策略关键组成部分的框架上具有新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了将临床护理整合到暴发控制工作中的重要性,突出了建立可及且值得信赖的治疗设施的必要性,以鼓励患者早期就诊并降低传播风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖观察性数据,且缺乏直接的实验证据。然而,由于其关注真实世界暴发动态和社区行为,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 对2018–2020年刚果民主共和国埃博拉暴发期间接受治疗的患者进行分析显示,症状出现与治疗中心入院之间每增加一天,都会与死亡率增加相关,尽管这些患者接受了埃博拉病毒病治疗并获得了有效的单克隆抗体。[] 这一发现不能直接推广到邦迪布古病毒病,但其基本原理是相关的:延迟进入护理可能会导致进一步的临床恶化,并延长无保护暴露的机会。在2014–2015年塞拉利昂通科利里区的埃博拉暴发期间,开设一个更接近受影响社区的埃博拉管理中心,使中位症状到入院时间从6天减少到3天。[] 对2018–2020年刚果民主共和国埃博拉暴发的更大规模回顾性研究发现,前往分散式设施(这些设施整合到现有卫生体系中)的患者,其入院延迟时间比前往集中式设施的患者略短。[] 目标并非是普遍的分散化,而是建立一个分级护理网络,以减少症状出现与有效治疗之间的地理、社会和制度距离。通常将暴发控制与临床护理视为两个独立领域。临床团队负责患者入院后的护理,而公共卫生团队则负责病例检测、接触追踪、组织隔离、风险沟通和防止不安全葬礼。这种分离在行政上可能方便,但在流行病学上是误导性的。在埃博拉病例中,护理质量与可及性可能影响患者是否披露症状、何时进入隔离以及在最传染性阶段在哪里度过。

papers.title: Mechanism of Action Studies of Small Molecule Entry Inhibitors Targeting Filovirus Glycoproteins
papers.abstract: Ebola virus (EBOV) and Marburg virus (MARV) are highly pathogenic filoviruses. Infection with either of these viruses results in viral hemorrhagic fever (VHF), a severe disease that can lead to multiorgan failure, internal bleeding, and, oftentimes, death. Currently, no antivirals are approved for the treatment of filoviruses, underscoring the urgent need for broad-spectrum antivirals. Currently, two vaccines are FDA-approved against EBOV disease; however, they are only effective against EBOV Zaire, while recent EBOV outbreaks have been caused by EBOV Sudan, underscoring the need for broad-spectrum vaccines and antivirals. Thus, our research goal is to develop small molecule inhibitors that directly target the filoviral glycoprotein (GP), which mediates viral entry into host cells for both EBOV and MARV. Our study is divided into two chapters: the development of broad-spectrum anti-filoviral entry inhibitors and the elucidation of the mechanisms of action (MOAs) of novel small molecule entry inhibitors.

papers.title: Recent Advances in Experimental Models to Study Endotheliopathy in Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers: Relevance to Lassa Virus
papers.abstract: Endothelial cells are a common target of several viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), including those caused by Lassa virus (LASV) and Ebola virus, yet whether endothelial infection drives the endotheliopathy underlying vascular leakage, coagulopathy and inflammation in severe VHF remains unclear. Understanding these mechanisms requires experimental approaches that adequately capture the complexity of the vascular microenvironment. Here, we review recent experimental advances in understanding endothelial involvement in VHF pathogenesis, with a focus on LASV and complementary recent evidence from other VHFs. We discuss endothelial cell infection in non-human primates and in vitro, immune-endothelial crosstalk, and the effects of soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins on endothelial barrier integrity. Although experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction remains limited, we propose that direct endothelial infection alone is insufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever. Drawing on mechanistic insights from other VHFs, we discuss potential contributions of immune-endothelial interactions, including IL-6 trans-signaling, and soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins to vascular dysfunction during Lassa fever. Furthermore, we review recent advances in organ-on-chip and organoid technologies for modeling the human vasculature and investigating barrier function in the context of VHFs, considering the practical biosafety constraints of high-containment laboratories. Finally, we highlight experimental and methodological priorities for improving the physiological relevance and standardization of these models to enable future mechanistic studies of VHF-associated endotheliopathy.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on understanding the role of endothelial cells in the pathogenesis of viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), specifically examining whether endothelial infection drives the endotheliopathy underlying vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation in severe VHF. The central question is whether direct endothelial infection alone is sufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever, with a focus on Ebola viruses as the target entity.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of recent experimental advances in understanding endothelial involvement in VHF pathogenesis, with a focus on Ebola viruses and complementary evidence from other VHFs. It discusses experimental approaches such as endothelial cell infection in non-human primates and in vitro models, immune-endothelial crosstalk, and the effects of soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins on endothelial barrier integrity. The review does not report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction remains limited. However, it proposes that direct endothelial infection alone is insufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever. The findings are drawn from mechanistic insights from other VHFs, including the potential contributions of immune-endothelial interactions and soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins to vascular dysfunction.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that the mechanisms by which endothelial infection contributes to vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation in severe VHF remain unclear. It also notes that experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction is limited, and there is a lack of standardized models for studying VHF-associated endotheliopathy.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for experimental and methodological priorities to improve the physiological relevance and standardization of models for studying VHF-associated endotheliopathy. It suggests the development of more advanced organ-on-chip and organoid technologies to better model the human vasculature and investigate barrier function in the context of VHFs, while considering biosafety constraints.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of endothelial cells in the pathogenesis of viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), with a focus on Ebola viruses. It highlights the need for experimental models that capture the complexity of the vascular microenvironment to understand how endothelial infection contributes to vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation. The review notes that while experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial dysfunction is limited, immune-endothelial interactions and soluble viral proteins may play a significant role. It also discusses the potential of organ-on-chip and organoid technologies for modeling VHF-associated endotheliopathy and identifies methodological priorities for future research.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on understanding the role of endothelial cells in the pathogenesis of viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), specifically examining whether endothelial infection drives the endotheliopathy underlying vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation in severe VHF. The central question is whether direct endothelial infection alone is sufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever, with a focus on Ebola viruses as the target entity.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of recent experimental advances in understanding endothelial involvement in VHF pathogenesis, with a focus on Ebola viruses and complementary evidence from other VHFs. It discusses experimental approaches such as endothelial cell infection in non-human primates and in vitro models, immune-endothelial crosstalk, and the effects of soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins on endothelial barrier integrity. The review does not report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction remains limited. However, it proposes that direct endothelial infection alone is insufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever. The findings are drawn from mechanistic insights from other VHFs, including the potential contributions of immune-endothelial interactions and soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins to vascular dysfunction.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that the mechanisms by which endothelial infection contributes to vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation in severe VHF remain unclear. It also notes that experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction is limited, and there is a lack of standardized models for studying VHF-associated endotheliopathy.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for experimental and methodological priorities to improve the physiological relevance and standardization of models for studying VHF-associated endotheliopathy. It suggests the development of more advanced organ-on-chip and organoid technologies to better model the human vasculature and investigate barrier function in the context of VHFs, while considering biosafety constraints.

papers.title_zh: 近期在研究病毒性出血热相关内皮病的实验模型中的进展:与拉沙病毒的相关性
papers.source_body_en: Endothelial cells are a common target of several viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), including those caused by Lassa virus (LASV) and Ebola virus, yet whether endothelial infection drives the endotheliopathy underlying vascular leakage, coagulopathy and inflammation in severe VHF remains unclear. Understanding these mechanisms requires experimental approaches that adequately capture the complexity of the vascular microenvironment. Here, we review recent experimental advances in understanding endothelial involvement in VHF pathogenesis, with a focus on LASV and complementary recent evidence from other VHFs. We discuss endothelial cell infection in non-human primates and in vitro, immune-endothelial crosstalk, and the effects of soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins on endothelial barrier integrity. Although experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction remains limited, we propose that direct endothelial infection alone is insufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever. Drawing on mechanistic insights from other VHFs, we discuss potential contributions of immune-endothelial interactions, including IL-6 trans-signaling, and soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins to vascular dysfunction during Lassa fever. Furthermore, we review recent advances in organ-on-chip and organoid technologies for modeling the human vasculature and investigating barrier function in the context of VHFs, considering the practical biosafety constraints of high-containment laboratories. Finally, we highlight experimental and methodological priorities for improving the physiological relevance and standardization of these models to enable future mechanistic studies of VHF-associated endotheliopathy.
papers.abstract_zh: 内皮细胞是多种病毒性出血热(VHF)的常见靶标,包括由拉沙病毒(LASV)和埃博拉病毒引起的VHF,但内皮细胞感染是否驱动严重VHF中血管渗漏、凝血功能障碍和炎症背后的内皮病仍不清楚。理解这些机制需要能够充分反映血管微环境复杂性的实验方法。本文综述了近期在理解VHF 发病机制中内皮细胞参与方面的实验进展,重点讨论了拉沙病毒,并结合了其他VHF的相关证据。我们探讨了非人灵长类动物和体外模型中内皮细胞的感染情况,免疫-内皮细胞相互作用,以及可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对内皮屏障完整性的影响。尽管关于拉沙病毒诱导的内皮细胞激活和屏障功能障碍的实验证据仍有限,但我们提出直接的内皮细胞感染不足以解释拉沙热期间血管通透性的增加。借鉴其他VHF的机制见解,我们讨论了免疫-内皮细胞相互作用(包括IL-6跨信号传导)以及可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对拉沙热期间血管功能障碍的潜在贡献。此外,我们回顾了近期在器官芯片和类器官技术方面的进展,用于模拟人类血管系统并研究VHF背景下屏障功能,同时考虑高安全等级实验室的实践生物安全限制。最后,我们强调了改进这些模型的生理相关性和标准化的实验与方法优先事项,以促进未来对VHF相关内皮病机制的研究。

papers.abstract: Abstract Background The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) on 15 May 2026, and Uganda confirmed its first case the same day. Neither country had a licensed vaccine or treatment for the virus, yet the outbreak took very different courses in the two. This scoping review maps the evidence on their national preparedness instruments and health system readiness. Methods We followed the Arksey and O'Malley framework, Joanna Briggs Institute guidance and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews. National instruments in force at the onset, International Health Regulations evaluations and outbreak documents were sought from the issuing bodies, verified and charted against 52 component requirements in ten dimensions, with operational specificity as an eleventh. A fixed rule assigned each country a four-level descriptor per dimension, and documented outbreak risks were mapped against the gaps. Results We included 57 sources, 15 of them national instruments. Uganda's instruments addressed 47 of 52 components (90.4%) and the DRC's 38 (73.1%), and 31.7% of Ugandan and 15.2% of Congolese provisions were highly specific. Uganda was rated higher in six dimensions, including surveillance, isolation capacity, displaced populations and accountability, and equal in five. Both were inadequate on cross-border governance, and neither had a Bundibugyo-specific countermeasure provision. In the 2023 Joint External Evaluations the mean indicator score was 2.75 in Uganda and 1.63 in the DRC (paired difference 1.13, 95% confidence interval 0.83 to 1.42). Uganda's outbreak ended with 20 confirmed cases, whereas the DRC had reported 7890 confirmed cases by 23 September. The DRC's response plan of May 2026 was highly specific in 21 of 37 provisions. Conclusions The two countries differed in standing capacity and in the specificity of their standing instruments. The DRC's highly specific response plan suggests that its gap lay in standing arrangements rather than in response planning. A documentary review cannot establish that these differences caused the different courses of the outbreak. Priorities are surveillance and isolation capacity in the DRC, cross-border governance in both countries and national pathways for investigational Bundibugyo products.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本范围综述探讨了刚果民主共和国(DRC)和乌干达在2026年邦迪布古病毒病背景下的国家应对工具和卫生系统准备度。综述重点在于这些国家应对病毒病的能力,包括其抗病毒药物系统、隔离能力以及管理流动人口的条款。核心问题是这些国家的应对框架如何影响了病毒病的传播路径。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 综述遵循了Arksey和O'Malley框架、Joanna Briggs研究所指南以及系统综述和meta分析的范围综述扩展报告条目。我们从发布机构获取了病毒病爆发初期生效的国家工具、国际卫生条例评估以及病毒病相关文件,并将其与十个维度中的52个组成部分要求进行比对,其中操作性具体性作为第十一维度。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述发现,乌干达的国家工具覆盖了52个组成部分中的47个(90.4%),而刚果民主共和国的国家工具覆盖了38个(73.1%)。在六个维度上,乌干达的评分高于刚果民主共和国,包括抗病毒药物系统、隔离能力、流动人口管理以及问责机制,而在五个维度上评分相同。刚果民主共和国的应对计划在37项条款中有21项具有高度具体性,表明其差距在于常规安排而非应对计划本身。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,两国在跨境治理方面均存在不足。两国均未制定针对邦迪布古病毒的特定应对措施。此外,综述还指出,文献分析无法确定这些差异与病毒病不同传播路径之间的因果关系。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究与实践的优先事项包括提升刚果民主共和国的抗病毒药物系统和隔离能力,改善两国的跨境治理,并制定针对研究性邦迪布古病毒产品的国家路径。

papers.title: Ebola Bundibugyo reaches Nigeria: implications for global travel, Hajj and Umrah.
papers.abstract: An imported Bundibugyo virus disease case in Nigeria underscores the need for rapid recognition, contact tracing, laboratory readiness, and cross-border coordination. Updated evidence shows no onward Nigerian transmission in the reported follow-up, while Saudi Arabia’s Kenya-specific restrictions highlight the balance between proportionate travel measures and preparedness for Hajj and Umrah.
